pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Valentina Studio is a cross-platform GUI database client by Paradigma Software for DuckDB, ValentinaDB, MongoDB, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server and SQLite. It bundles a SQL editor with autocompletion, schema and query designers, diagramming, data transfer and import/ export tools.
This package installs the prebuilt amd64 binary published by upstream as a .deb release artifact under /opt/VStudio. Qt6, ICU and the Valentina runtime libraries are bundled inside that prefix; only a small set of system X11/GTK/glibc libraries is pulled in via RDEPEND.
The Free Edition requires registration with a no-cost serial number obtained from Paradigma Software on first launch.
